public_rationale: The 45% and 50% figures come from an informal experiment by Marcus and Davis. The only record of the prompts, outputs and scoring is their own NYU report, which cannot be used as evidence that they were right. No independent rerun or audit was found. Their own table lists 157 tests in 2020 and 80 in 2022, which also raises the question of whether the two percentages cover the same examples. The claim cannot be confirmed or refuted from independent evidence.
limitations: Only the speakers' own data exists.
Model outputs are non-deterministic, and older model versions have been retired.

criteria.support_condition: An independent rerun or audit of the authors' example set confirming roughly 45% right in 2020 and 50% right in June 2022.
criteria.contradiction_condition: An independent audit of the same examples and outputs showing materially different success rates, or showing that the two runs did not cover the same examples.
